title: Seko Tengah language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Sulawesi, Indonesia
extract: Seko Tengah is an Austronesian language spoken in the North Luwu Regency of South Sulawesi, Indonesia. Together with Seko Padang, Panasuan and Budong-Budong, it belongs to the Seko branch of the South Sulawesi subgroup.
